featured_reviews.name: Dhanashree Niphadkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Experience!

This was a corporate order, and we ended up waiting over an hour for our food, only to be met with complete disappointment.

Our order was significantly delayed, and despite calling the restaurant multiple times, no one answered. When I contacted the first delivery partner assigned to the order, he informed me that he had returned the parcel to the restaurant because the raita was leaking. What was frustrating was that neither the restaurant nor the delivery partner informed me about this. He then mentioned that another delivery partner would be assigned since he had already waited too long.

When the food finally arrived, we discovered that one of the main items, Kadhai Paneer, was missing. On top of that, none of the raitas or salads that were supposed to accompany the three biryanis were included.

This was a corporate meal, and several people were left hungry due to the missing items and poor handling of the order. As a Swiggy One member who orders regularly, this has been one of the worst experiences I've had. I will never order from Street Foods by Punjab Grill again and would strongly discourage others from doing so.

Very disappointing service and a complete lack of accountability.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Dhanashree Niphadkar,

It’s truly disheartening to hear about your experience, especially with a corporate order where everyone was counting on us. We understand how frustrating it must have been to wait over an hour and then receive a missing Kadhai Paneer along with the raita and salads. We’re sorry for the lack of communication regarding the delivery issues and the disappointment this caused. Your feedback is invaluable, and we’ll make sure to address these concerns with our team.

please share your contact number and outlet location with us at contact@sfbypg.com.

Warmest regards,
Team Street foods by Punjab Grill

featured_reviews.name: Prasad K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vikhroli Social – Elevated Experience with a Spacious Rooftop

I recently visited Vikhroli Social with my office colleagues, and it turned out to be a better experience than my previous visits. The key improvement was their expanded rooftop space. Earlier, the rooftop was more like a small balcony, but now it’s a huge, open, and spacious area. If you prefer a quieter atmosphere without loud music, the rooftop is definitely the best spot. It offers ample space and a relaxed vibe, although the bench table seating felt a bit too compact and could have been more comfortable.

We were a group of four and ordered a variety of dishes. The Veg Platter was average — nothing exceptional, but decent. The Munchao Soup, on the other hand, was quite good with a rich and flavorful broth. We also tried Fish and Chips, which were good but could have been seasoned better. The fish options were quite limited, which was a bit disappointing. However, the corn starter was a pleasant surprise — crispy, well-seasoned, and delicious.

The highlight of the evening was the Wings Platter, which came with four different types of wings. Each preparation had a distinct flavor profile — some spicy, some sweet with BBQ sauce — and every single one tasted amazing. The variety and quality of the wings truly stood out.

Overall, it was a great experience, especially because of the improved rooftop setup. The spacious and relaxed atmosphere, combined with good food and service, made it a memorable evening. If you’re visiting Vikhroli Social, the rooftop is definitely the place to be!

featured_reviews.name: jignesh kale
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the tastiest experience i have ever encountered, we ate like there was no tomorrow, even though my stomach was full, my taste buds needed more. The first Dosa we tried "Butter Chicken Dosa" and trust my words, this is coming from a butter chicken fan, you would have never tried such a fabulous butter chicken in your life, it was different and finger licking good, the chicken gravy which is standard for all non veg dosas is so good that you will definitely ask for it once more per serving. After which we tried Prawns Dosa, although I do not have sea food, the review from my friends was awesome, and no wonder they were all attacking a single plate like they haven't eaten in ages. Lastly if you are a sharma fan, shwarma dosa is for you, It's and out of the world experience that combines the sanity of a simple dish like dhosa with the vivid taste of shwarma, It checked out all the boxes to blow are minds with its unusual taste. In all the experience was one a kind, and I will recommend it as one of the best food truck experience.
